elsewhere.note: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth, and wastes away. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and…
There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.
Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.
